beats.title: Arrival at the Mireward wall
beats.summary: The heroes enter Mireward as Lysandra recognizes her father; the gold fixture separately grounds the Lysandro name from the inn debate span.

beats.title: Edge warning message read
beats.summary: Lysandra reads the Edge message and connects it to Mirathorn monsters and eye changes.

beats.title: Orik Tane inn debate
beats.summary: At the inn, Orik Tane commands a fearful debate over whether Edge is truly threatened.

beats.title: North gate alarm
beats.summary: A terrified boy reports shadows from the Reach, and Stafl flies to scout the north gate road.

beats.title: Edge refugees arrive
beats.summary: Brin Holloway leads roughly fifty Edge survivors to the gate while Ephanna demands eye checks.

beats.title: Eye checks and south-gate plan
beats.summary: Stafl sends survivors to the south gate while the party sets defenses along the north wall.

beats.title: First wave enemy reveal
beats.summary: The first wave resolves into tripods, meatwings, hybrids, sewer monsters, and a golem-like creature.

beats.title: Hunger of Hadar and readied attacks
beats.summary: Ephanna drops Hunger of Hadar while the party readies attacks as monsters enter range.

evidence_refs.label: Hunger of Hadar and readied attacks

beats.title: Tripod body launch
beats.summary: Tripods rip off body parts and launch them toward the wall, creating small summoned meat monsters.

beats.title: Lysandra Commanding Shout
beats.summary: Lysandra orders Karsemine, Bonogo, and Baergrom into another volley against flying monsters.

beats.title: Karsemine learns fire weakness
beats.summary: Karsemine uses Hunter’s Mark to discover the tripod creatures resist poison and are weak to fire.

beats.title: Caelynn hit and Lysandra counterattack
beats.summary: A thrown monster hits Caelynn and becomes a meatwing, creating openings for Karsemine and Lysandra.

beats.title: Meatwing charm
beats.summary: Remaining meatwings cast a charm that makes Bonogo and Ephanna stop feeling compelled to attack them.

beats.title: Caelynn lightning-bolt cliffhanger
beats.summary: Caelynn unleashes lightning through the attackers, ending on whether it is enough to save Mireward.
